programme.desc: Mr Bean is waiting for Irma at the park for a picnic, when he sees a nervous man rehearsing an engagement proposal to his girlfriend. Mr Bean tries to show him how it’s done but manages to send the engagement ring flying! It lands in a bicycle basket, gets flicked into a pram, flung onto an ice cream - Mr Bean has to chase it around the park as it keeps being launched from place to place, in the hope he can save the day!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (17)
programme.desc: Grizzy has prepared himself a TV dinner to eat in front of his favorite series. But his moment of pleasure is abruptly interrupted by unexplained static. Grizzy rapidly discovers that the true "interference" is the Lemmings, who are using the TV antenna as a diving board for their water games.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (18)
programme.desc: The Lemmings are having a rave party. When Grizzy throws their ghetto blaster into the river, he sparks a general power outage. Unless he finds an alternative source of energy, and before the Lemmings do, he can kiss his TV night goodbye!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (19)
programme.desc: When he realizes that his beloved she-bear adores the smell of flowers, Grizzy decides to offer her the geraniums that decorate the window ledges of the ranger's cabin. Can he bring them to her without the Lemmings, who are skating out by the caribou dung pit and trash bins, ruining his desired effect?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (20)
programme.desc: Decidedly, this is not Grizzy's day: after making a fool of himself in front of the she-bear he's in love with, he is ousted from the log cabin by the Lemmings, who are in top form. Grizzy lands in a field of clover where he notices that one of them - which has four leaves - seems to bring him good luck. Could his chance be changing?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (21)
programme.desc: Grizzy can¿t believe his eyes when he sees objects moving all by themselves. When he realizes it¿s the Lemmings who are playing around with a particularly powerful magnet, he has a stroke of genius. He will design a telekinesis trick to impress his beloved she-bear.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (22)
programme.desc: Further to a misunderstanding, Grizzy is persuaded that the she-bear he's in love with has been turned into a frog. Whilst he looks through the ranger's books of fairytales, searching for a means to return his beloved to her original form, the Lemmings try to recover the frog, with whom they have so much fun playing rodeo games.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (23)
programme.desc: Grizzy discovers a baby raccoon not far from the log cabin. When he sees its big moist eyes, Grizzy melts and adopts the creature. When the Lemmings drag the baby into their dangerous games, the overprotective Grizzy steps in, provoking even more perilous situations!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (24)
programme.desc: By pure chance, Grizzy discovers the pleasures of video games on the ranger's console. The Lemmings want to try their hand at the joystick but Grizzy refuses to interrupt his Kart racing game. They try everything, including temptation, to get him away from the console but there's nothing doing, Grizzy is addicted.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (25)
programme.desc: Grizzy builds a look-alike robot to keep the Lemmings away while he prepares a popcorn party for his beloved she-bear. But his double¿s artificial intelligence truly leaves to be desired. If only it were as clever as the original...

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (26)
programme.desc: When she is accidentally hit over the head, the she-bear Grizzy¿s in love thinks she¿s a Lemming. Grizzy thinks that another little well-placed bang over the head will knock her ideas back into place. The only problem is that the Lemmings, who are delighted to have a new playmate, have no intention of letting him proceed with his plan.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (27)
programme.desc: When a meteorite falls not far from the log cabin, strange berries start to grow. One of their properties is that they make anyone who eats them grow to disproportionate sizes.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (28)
programme.desc: Under the wood floor of the log cabin, Grizzy and the Lemmings discover the entrance to an underground gallery with an old treasure card that indicates the location of a treasure. Upon closer look, the representation of this treasure greatly resembles a giant jar of chocolate spread.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (29)
programme.desc: When he brandishes a native american scepter that the Lemmings brought home with other antique objects, Grizzy sees the Lemmings bow low before him and behave like servants. One of them has escaped the spell, but he will have to confront both Grizzy and his fellow creatures in order to recover the scepter and reverse the spell.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (30)
programme.desc: Grizzy tries to impress the she-bear that he's in love with by making a sculpture of her from a piece of wood. But as soon as the artist's back is turned, the Lemmings gnaw at the work of art in order to transform it into a toboggan slide. Grizzy must succeed in getting rid of the Lemmings without his model realizing what's going on. An Art in itself!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (31)
programme.desc: The Lemmings throw a surprise birthday party for one of the clan. When "Happy Birthday" rings out, the surpriiiiiise! is as great for Grizzy, who is trying to take a nap after a hearty meal, as it is for the birthday Lemming hero in question. From that point on, Grizzy has only one objective: stop the din, which is not at all helping his migraine headache. But for the Lemmings, the party must go on at any price.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (28)
programme.desc: Mr Bean wants to take a photo of a rare bird, the Rosy Starling, hoping to win a cash prize from a nature magazine. But the special nuts he’s bought to lure the bird have instead attracted a couple of persistent squirrels, who keep hopping onto the bird table he’s installed and helping themselves to the tasty nuts. It’s Bean vs squirrels, or so he thinks…

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (29)
programme.desc: Mr Bean buys himself a DIY remote-controlled boat kit so he can compete in a race on the local pond. But just as he’s about to finish it, Scrapper sniffs out some nearby sandwiches and causes havoc. In the confusion, Mr Bean thinks the cat has swallowed the rudder of his toy boat, so has to capture him and take him to the vet. Will he get his rudder back in time for the race?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (16)
programme.desc: After a regrettable episode involving his landlady sleepwalking into his room, Mr. Bean suddenly finds himself out on his ear with nowhere to live. Near to tears, he yearns for the cosy familiarity of his old home. A scarecrow and a pair of false teeth come to his rescue.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (17)
programme.desc: An old photo album causes Bean to reminisce about his lovely summers at scout camp as a boy, and sets him planning a night under the stars with Teddy. Purchasing a tent becomes a tricky problem - but nothing will stop him having a good time, even if he has to get the garden shed over the roof of his house.

programme.title: Moley (41)
programme.desc: It’s the anniversary of Café Moley. But Lester isn’t feeling himself, Moley conjures up a spell and they get sucked into Manny and go on a journey through Lester’s past.

programme.title: Moley (42)
programme.desc: All of MoleTown goes into a cleaning frenzy after Moley tries to explain why humans in the Great Above think dirt is dirty!

programme.title: Moley (43)
programme.desc: Moley tries to impress the new ambassador from MoleTown’s sister city, Moledonia, meanwhile the Gardener has schemed up a free tour in order to get his hands on Manny.

programme.title: Moley (44)
programme.desc: It’s winter in MoleTown and a mysterious snowy creature is roaming the Big Below, the Gardener uses this as the perfect opportunity to try and scare Moley with his own Abominable Snowmole, and catch Manny.

programme.title: Moley (45)
programme.desc: All of MoleTown enjoys a day at the beach. But when they found out Mona Lisa can’t swim, Mishmosh comes to the rescue with his new submarine invention!

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables (15)
programme.desc: Puff wants to impress Sushi-Mushi by showing him how he can use his fog to steam food. But Sushi-Mushi thinks Puff wants to be his cooking rival!

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables (16)
programme.desc: Mush-Mush and Lilit discover that each of them has a favourite beetle. This is great! They’re beetle buddies! However this quickly turns into a competition on who has the ‘best’ beetle...

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables (17)
programme.desc: Having learnt that Starmush overcame his fear of the Dark Forest by staying a night there when he was a Mushler, Mush-Mush and Lilit convince Chep that they should do the same. But will they end up fearless or fearful?

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables (18)
programme.desc: The Mushlers’ home-tree isn’t big enough to store all of Chep’s collections. So Chep goes all around Mushton to find a new home for them - and no way he’s letting them move out without him!

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables (19)
programme.desc: Mush-Mush is the champ of finding Mushables in their version of ‘hide-and-seek’ - ‘Hide your Hat’. The last one he needs to find is Mushpot. But Mushpot is the champ of hiding!

programme.title: SuperThings: Rivals of Kaboom - Kazoom Power (30)
programme.desc: A runaway train is carrying a Kazoom fragment. Heroes and villains must work together to prevent it from crashing into Kaboom City.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (24)
programme.desc: When a gorgeous feline walks into the Cat and Mouse Detective Agency, Tom is immediately smitten. But someone has already stolen her heart—a heart-shaped cake made for a gangster and his fiancée on their upcoming engagement. He asked for the expensive engagement ring to be baked into the batter as a Valentine's Day surprise, but the cake and the jewelry were stolen from the bakery window.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (25)
programme.desc: Inside the house, Tom and Jerry get into a full-on brawl. Steam comes out of their ears as they face off. Just then, Ginger and Rick walk in, grab both by the scruff of their necks, and says they have to learn to deal with their anger. Ginger shoves a copy of an anger management book at them. Spike and Tom both roll their eyes but agree to make an effort.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (26)
programme.desc: Old Snelgrove, the senior butler, is retiring. There is an open backyard Olympics on the estate to see who will replace him. When the contestants in the field are narrowed down to Butch and Tom, what will the final outcome be?

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (27)
programme.desc: Red Herring complains to Tom and Jerry that he keeps hearing laughter everywhere he goes. Tom and Jerry bodyguard Red to prevent him from doing anything that might provoke laughter, but Red's goof-ups and fails soon have even them convulsed. Gradually, it gets loud enough that Tom and Jerry can hear it too. Will they find the true source of the laughter?

programme.title: Batwheels (17)
programme.desc: When Batcomputer shuts down for a system update, the other Batwheels must take over for her while aiding Batman in a battle against Harley Quinn.

programme.title: Batwheels (18)
programme.desc: MOE wants to know what it's like to be a member of the Batwheels, but the bot gets more than he bargained for when Bam invites him along for an exciting mission to stop Poison Ivy.

programme.title: Ben 10 (23)
programme.desc: While in Paris, France, Ben catches Zombozo robbing the Louvre, but when Zombozo hypnotizes Ben to remain speechless, Ben must navigate a foreign land like a mime in order to stop the criminal clown and his travelling circus.

programme.title: Ben 10 (24)
programme.desc: Team Tennyson checks out a Samurai Museum in Tokyo, where Ben is too impatient to wait out the Calligraphy experience for the more exciting sounding Samurai one. But when a dangerous Samurai sword is stolen from the exhibit, Ben must take on its thief, the new Big Bad in town, the Forever Knight.

programme.title: Ben 10 (10)
programme.desc: During a stop at the superstore Shoppë, Ben and Gwen are transformed into babies by nanny-gone-nuts Nanny Nightmare, who will stop at nothing to reshape the world in the image of her daycare.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (1)
programme.desc: While climbing back to the cabin carrying a load of delicious berries, Grizzy trips and falls over backwards. He performs a series of acrobatics worthy of a diving champ and resurfaces safe and sound despite himself. The Lemmings, who saw everything, are in awe and treat Grizzy like an idol. Grizzy starts to enjoy this VIP treatment until the Lemmings ask him to repeat his exploit. Grizzy agrees but discovers that the Lemmings have built a giant diving board for the occasion.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (2)
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings lose their jar of chocolate spread in a labyrinthian Temple. Determined to recover their favorite afternoon snack, they confront one another in the maze, but end up getting totally lost. Grizzy finds himself back at square one and decides to find something to make holes in the walls and cheat. As for the Lemmings, they discover a magic map of the place that enables you to orient yourself and modify the corridors in real time. Which cheater will win?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (3)
programme.desc: Things start to disappear from the log cabin as if by magic. Grizzy is persuaded that the Lemmings are the culprits, but the Lemmings are also victims of inexplicable thefts. As they argue, Grizzy and the Lemmings discover the true authors of the repeated thefts: a gang of fanatic partridges who bring stolen objects as offerings to their goddess, a giant partridge. Grizzy and Lemmings join forces to infiltrate the nest and recover their belongings.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (4)
programme.desc: A frog swallows an ancestral jewel that bestows it with the power of mind control. Grizzy uses the frog to swallow the flies that have proliferated in the cabin, and which now let themselves be docilely caught. The Lemmings don’t miss a thing. They decide to get hold of the frog to hypnotize an uncooperative tapir who refuses to play rodeo. Grizzy hypnotizes the Lemmings, who become his servants. But several Lemmings escaped and are preparing a rescue mission.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (5)
programme.desc: A military convoy has an accident while transporting top-secret material. In the impact, a technological sphere flies out and rolls over to Grizzy, who was gathering berries in the forest. Grizzy realizes that the sphere is a sort of compass that indicates the direction of his desires. He follows it and finds a bush overflowing with his favorite berries. The Lemmings recover the compass to find super game sites in the forest.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (6)
programme.desc: Grizzy finds a hand-shaped scepter ornated with a gold nugget that covers anything it touches with gold. Grizzy uses the object to “gold leaf” the Lemmings and swipe their chocolate bar. The Lemmings use their golden casts as armors to recover their chocolate. During the combat, the gold nugget is replaced by a chocolate one: the scepter now coats everything with chocolate. The Lemmings snatch it and flee.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (7)
programme.desc: The Lemmings organize a dance contest where the first prize is a jar of chocolate spread. Grizzy is hungry and decides to participate. He partners up with a talented dancing parrot and wins. Incapable of sharing, Grizzy and the Lemmings fight over the prize. The parrot brings the jar to a temple devoted to the glory of dancing parrots. To get it back, Grizzy and the Lemmings must perform a choreography. They decide to rehearse together.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (8)
programme.desc: Grizzy finds a strange creature fossilized in amber resin that resembles him. A natural science encyclopedia confirms that it’s his ancestor. Grizzy wants to take the block of amber, but the Lemmings fight him for it because the blue animal with big teeth is their ancestor too. The block cracks during their fight and frees the ancestor who turns out to be a rather unmanageable burden.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (9)
programme.desc: The Lemmings find a strange card game representing the elements along with instructions. The idea is to pretend that the ground is on fire or of ice, like in the game “Floor is Lava.” They transform the cabin into a giant adventure trail. Depending on the card drawn, they must avoid zones on the floor with flames or wax. Grizzy unceremoniously gets rids of the setup to regain control of the cabin. One of the cards lands on a stone slab that transforms into lava.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (10)
programme.desc: The Lemmings discover a very particular cocoa tree with chocolate-spread sap! Reduced to eating canned Brussels sprouts, the only remaining food in the cabin, Grizzy is baffled when he sees the Lemmings parading past to equip themselves with all sorts of containers: ladles, soup spoons, bowls, buckets, basins, etc. He watches them through binoculars and discovers that they have planted a faucet in a tree where chocolate spread flows. Grizzy decides to siphon off their tree.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (11)
programme.desc: Grizzy expels the Lemmings from the cabin where they had built a cumbersome obstacle course. Peaceful at last and feeling lazy, he is determined not to leave his couch. The Lemmings discover a magic Mayan disc that allows you to choose instantaneous mutations of other animals’ features: bat wings, reindeer antlers, elephant trunks, etc. The mutant Lemmings return to the cabin, determined to continue playing their game while enjoying their new accessories.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (12)
programme.desc: As they fight over the last jar of chocolate spread, Grizzy and the Lemmings accidentally send it flying deep into the jungle. They both set out in search for the jar, but in a forest that dense, it’s an impossible mission. In a Mayan Temple, the Lemmings discover a magic bracelet that increases one’s sense of smell tenfold and use it to find the jar. Grizzy loses their trail, but finds some Mayan bracelets himself: one for eyesight and one for hearing.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (13)
programme.desc: Just as Grizzy is about to go to bed, he ousts the Lemmings who are holding a surprise party in the cabin. The Lemmings land in a Mayan Temple devoted to the moon. While toying with an ancestral console, the Lemmings set off a cosmic phenomenon that brings the moon, which is now the size of a disco ball, to the temple. In its aura, gravity becomes very weak. Enough to get rid of Grizzy and have a very original fiesta.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (11)
programme.desc: Mr Bean and Teddy are enjoying a day at the arcade, when Mr Bean gets carried away with the dance machine, knocking Teddy onto the floor. Teddy’s picked up, put on a trolley of stuffed toys and figurines - and soon enough, he’s been put in the claw machine as a prize! Mr Bean has run out of coins, so has to find a way of winning Teddy back without looking like he’s cheating!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (12)
programme.desc: Mr Bean and Teddy are looking forward to seeing a once-in-a-lifetime comet - but it won’t appear until 4am! He tries to stay up, but it’s useless - he keeps dropping off. So instead, Mr Bean decides to go to bed and set an alarm - yet he over-winds the clock and it breaks! With all the shops closed, his only option is to build his own complicated version to make sure he doesn’t miss the comet…

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (13)
programme.desc: Mrs Wicket makes Mr Bean drive her to the hospital to get her ingrown toenail seen to and asks him to wait. Mr Bean gets bored, and on a wander around the hospital he finds a spare doctor’s outfit with stethoscope - great Teddy - I’ll give you a check-up! But a nurse spots him, and thinking he’s a new doctor Mr Bean is asked to visit patients. How long can he keep it up before he’s found out?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (14)
programme.desc: Mr Bean is at the supermarket when he spots a cool fire engine ride - but the security guard makes it clear it’s for little kids only. Not to be deterred, Mr Bean tries everything he can to distract the guard to have his go on the ride. When he finally does get his go, it’s not as good as he thought it would be, especially when a real fire engine has to be called to help Mr Bean!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! (11)
programme.desc: A very bad parking choice on Fred's part leads the gang to an asteroid mining base in outer space where an alien virus appears to be infecting the crew one by one, turning them into evil skull-headed aliens. The paranoid, terrified gang must try to solve the mystery before the virus reaches them, as well - if it hasn't already!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! (12)
programme.desc: To escape a snowstorm, the gang checks into a creepy, massive hotel run by a man very strict about the hotel rules established by his deceased mother. The gang soon discovers the penalty for breaking the hotel rules is a horrifying scolding from the ghost of the owner's mother, herself!

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (73)
programme.desc: When Rick uploads a video of Tom getting his head stuck in Jerry's mouse hole, the video instantly goes viral and Tom becomes the laughing stock of the feline community. Now Tom must restore his reputation by catching Jerry and capturing it all on video. Easier said than done.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (74)
programme.desc: When a Hare loses to a Tortoise in the biggest race of the year, he comes to Tom and Jerry claiming foul play. It's up to the duo to see what's really behind the most famous race in history.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (75)
programme.desc: Hildie and Beatie return from the Ol' Time Goblin Fair with kettle corn, a giant stuffed warlock, and a piranha they won in the ball toss. Despite their warning not to touch the fish, Tom can't pass up a chance to eat the catch of the day! But first he has to get past Jerry who is determined to protect his new friend. When a failed attempt by Tom ends up with the fish bowl being shattered, Jerry quickly casts a spell with the wand that allows the fish to breathe on dry land!

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (76)
programme.desc: Butch is bobbing for apple cores when he spots a dolled up Toodles heading his way! Butch slicks back his hair with some lard and strikes a pose. But she walks right past the alley cat. Meanwhile, inside the house, Tom spots Toodles headed in his direction. After a quick spruce up, Tom opens the door only to watch her walk right past the house. Tom slumps. Turns out Toodles is headed to Winston's house.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (77)
programme.desc: Wanting to cool off from the blistering heat, Tom and Jerry use a little magic to make it snow, turning the witches' world into a haunted winter wonderland with an evil snowman, haunted snow forts and magic snowball fights. Now they have to figure out how to make it stop snowing.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (78)
programme.desc: An overflowing trash bin filled with crumpled paper can mean only one thing…Tom is writing a novel - it's a mystery novel, of course! Tom soon realizes his book is playing out in real life (including the femme fatale who has taken an interest in the feline Mikey Spillane). At first, Tom has fun crafting his own fate, but soon realizes no matter how hard he tries to rewrite his story, he gets deeper and deeper into trouble.

programme.title: Tom and Jerry Gokko (1)
programme.desc: Jerry sneaks into the party set up to steal some cheese while Tom is sleeping. Tom wakes up and chases Jerry across a table filled with all kinds of food. During the chase, Tom eats a melon which turns him into a sphere shape and Jerry eats a piece of cheese which turns him into a triangle shape.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (33)
programme.desc: Mr Bean chases Scrapper around Mrs Wicket’s flat but her sideboard tumbles over and when Bean sees a bit of fur poking out from under it he is horrified to think he has squashed poor Scrapper. Not realizing that it’s only his landlady’s furry hat Bean rushes what he thinks is a flattened cat across town to the vets in a desperate attempt to save his feline friend’s life.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (34)
programme.desc: Mr Bean helps Mrs Wicket collect up all her money together after she witnesses a robbery. With all her cash safely locked in a bank vault Mrs Wicket suddenly finds she has a new admirer but Mr Bean doesn’t trust this smooth operator one bit. With wedding bells ringing Mr Bean races against time to solve the mystery and save Mrs Wicket…and her money.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (35)
programme.desc: Mr Bean loves Halloween and prepares to give the neighbourhood kids some tricks and treats they won’t forget. But when Mr Bean gets carried away with his spooky pranks he becomes the target of even more fiendish tricks from his neighbours the Bruisers.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (47)
programme.desc: When the frogspawn in Mr. Bean’s bath hatch out, it’s the last thing his landlady needs, especially when she’s invited the Mayor for tea. Hundreds of angry amphibians decide to invite themselves as well. Bean proves to be no expert at catching slippery green things that won’t stop hopping about all over the blinking place.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (48)
programme.desc: Mr. Bean meets an aristocratic old lady when he nearly runs over her lapdog with his mini. He’s thrilled to be invited for luncheon at her grand but strangely shabby mansion. Bean is determined to rise to the occasion. He’s so busy with matters of protocol he doesn’t notice that the lady and her sinister butler aren’t quite what they seem…

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (36)
programme.desc: Mr Bean is painting a picture of Teddy when he accidently squirts some green paint onto his brown wallpaper. Oh no! Bean needs to redecorate his room fast but ends up painting all the walls a garish lime green instead of brown. He’s so terrified of Mrs Wicket finding out that when he goes to bed he has some very weird nightmares - with a rather sickly ending.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (37)
programme.desc: Mr Bean is no fan of wrestling. But he’s promised to take Mrs Wicket and her friend Mrs Wince to a big wrestling match in town. Bean finds himself lost backstage at the stadium and accidentally wanders through a door and straight into the wrestling ring where he finds himself up against Side Kick Rick. More by luck than talent Bean wins the match - only to find that now he has to fight the terrifying Bruise Force.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings (4)
programme.desc: The Baby chipmunk has a collection of pretty gems. But when she loses a round one and it rolls past the Baby lemmings, they get the idea of organising a marble run. They collect lots of objects, cut them to make them spherical and... And off they go! But when the Baby chipmunk realises she's lost her stone, she wants it back. And when she sees all the new stones the Baby lemmings have collected, she wants them all back!

programme.title: Baby Lemmings (5)
programme.desc: Baby Owl can't sleep without her little owl blankie. But she loses it because she's clumsy. When the baby lemmings discover it, they think it's so cool they decide to include it in their activities - it really is a good friend! In a panic, Baby Owl looks for her comforter and tries to get it back from the baby lemmings, but her clumsiness gives them the impression that she wants to harm the comforter! The baby lemmings decide to protect the comforter against all odds!

programme.title: Baby Lemmings (6)
programme.desc: Baby Moose has a passion for little blue mushrooms (which look like a baby lemming lying on its belly), which he searches for like a truffle-hunting dog. But the baby lemmings, after seeing a butterfly disguised as a leaf, decide that day to play hide-and-seek. So when Baby Moose thinks he's going to find some mushrooms, the baby lemmings jump out of their hiding place. Baby Moose gets scared every time and decides to put an end to the baby lemmings' game.

programme.title: Batwheels (29)
programme.desc: After he takes down Riddler with an impressive wheel slam move, the Batwheels give Buff the nickname "Tough Buff." But Buff abruptly bristles at the name, leading the Batwheels to realize that it's not okay to call your friends nicknames that they don't like.

programme.title: Batwheels (30)
programme.desc: After being zapped by Penguin's Songinator ray, the Batwheels find themselves only able to communicate through song! They'll need to learn to harmonize as a team to defeat the musical prankster.

programme.title: Meet the Batwheels (24)
programme.desc: Bam gushes over his personal hero and idol - Batman! During an ongoing mission, Bam awes at all the cool moves and awesome antics that Batman shows off. Potentially can be done with existing footage.

programme.title: Ben 10 (25)
programme.desc: During a tour of the Japanese Robotics Museum, Ben finds hero-gone-wrong Tim Buktu "trying to save" Tokyo from a Dragon. Has Tim finally turned over a new leaf, or is this just another one of his half-baked plans to play the part of hero?

programme.title: Ben 10 (26)
programme.desc: At Biggie Box Japan, Ben waits in an epic line for the release of the latest Sumo Slammers video game, Cyber Slammers, but Ben must soon save the store, not from game-hungry customers, but from Steam Smythe, who wants to retro-fit a massive mech with steam punk powers!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! (11)

programme.desc: Jejich jedinou šancí na záchranu světa je obrátit tok času a vrátit se zpět do minulosti. Přísně tajné vládní experimenty s cestováním v čase musely být předčasně ukončeny, protože se vymkly kontrole a ohrožovaly bezpečnost světa. Vědecký garant projektu zmizel i s technologií a pátrání po něm je v plném proudu. Když se jeho jméno objeví v seznamu pasažérů letecké společnosti, vláda nařídí letadlu návrat. Ale stroj se během letu ztratí z radaru i z oblohy.

programme.title: V pasti
programme.desc: Mary Portmanová (Naomi Watts) je dětská psycholožka, která přišla při tragické automobilové nehodě o manžela. Její syn Stephen sice nehodu přežil, ale zůstal upoutaný na lůžko. Mary pečuje o vlastní paralyzované dítě, a i když se její život hroutí, dělá všechno, aby pomáhala i jiným dětem, které její pomoc potřebují. Zvlášť ji zaujme jeden nový pacient, malý Tom, který se po smrti matky uzavřel do sebe. Rozhodne se ho vzít k sobě, do jejího velkého domu uprostřed lesů.

programme.title: Umělá inteligence
programme.desc: Británie je uprostřed studené války s Čínou a její ministerstvo obrany pracuje na vývoji robotického vojáka. Když se bojový stroj vymkne kontrole a dojde ke krveprolití, šéf vývojářského týmu povolá na pomoc expertku na oblast umělé inteligence. Jejich vztah brzy začne překračovat pouto ryze pracovní, a právě tehdy se věci začnou komplikovat.

programme.title: Cesta za pokladem
programme.desc: Cesta za pokladem nebo mýty a legendy ze světa peněz je šestidílný veselý příběh pro děti o sourozencích Maxovi a Mili, kteří se vydají na cestu za pokladem, aby mohli koupit narozeninový dárek své mamince. Maxovi a Mili na jejich cestě pomáhá babi Majka a její pejsek Money. V každé epizodě se děti naučí něco zajímavého ze světa peněz a navíc zjistí, co vše může být vzácné jako poklad. Slovenský naučně-zábavný seriál

programme.title: Kikirikí
programme.desc: Kohoutek a slepička se stali nerozlučnými kamarády. Mají se velmi rádi, v noci spí vedle sebe na bidýlku a přes den spolu gazdují na dvoře. Kohoutek neustále něco vymýšlí, je nespokojený a slepička s ním všechno trpělivě řeší. Každý příběh v sobě ukrývá ponaučení, jak se stát lepším a neubližovat lidem, kteří nás mají rádi. Slovenská pohádka

programme.title: Kouzlování
programme.desc: Máte rádi kouzla, tajemství a čáry? V kouzelnické show vám renomovaný kouzelník poodhalí tajemství svých triků. Slovenský zábavný pořad (skryté titulky)

programme.title: Zabij nudu!
programme.desc: Dochází vám fantazie, co dělat doma s dětmi? Je tu pořad, v němž dostanete návod, jak spolu smysluplně prožít společně strávený čas. A také jak vyrobit jedinečné věci, které oživí vaši domácnost. Zažijete přitom určitě spoustu zábavy! Jsou to věci funkční, dekorační nebo jen pro zábavu, například pomůcky do školy, pokladničky či žertovné ozdoby. Slovenský tvůrčí pořad

programme.title: Staré pověsti české (11)
programme.desc: Animované Staré pověsti české vznikly ve vlastní produkci televizí CS Film a CS Mini. Producenti televize hledali velký příběh, který by připomínal tradice a naši minulost. Jan Werich o Jiráskovi, podle jehož námětu byl seriál natočen, řekl: „Kdyby Jirásek žil v Hollywoodu, byl by milionář, protože měl výborné zápletky.“ Oslavoval český národ, ale ne na úkor jiných. Tu a tam zušlechťoval naši historii a prokládal ji sentimentálními příběhy, a tak nám ji přibližoval a činil bližší.

programme.title: Bílý tesák (12)
programme.desc: Klasické dílo světové dobrodružné literatury Bílý tesák od Jacka Londona ožívá ve dvanáctidílném seriálu, který je vytvořen originální animační technikou. Živá kresba zachycuje na pozadí nehostinné Aljašky v době vrcholící zlaté horečky osud psa, v jehož žilách koluje vlčí krev. Český animovaný seriál

programme.title: O Mikešovi (5)
programme.desc: Animovaný seriál O kocouru Mikešovi a jeho přátelích, podle knihy Josefa Lady. Československý animovaný seriál

programme.title: Mach a Šebestová (6)
programme.desc: Jednou šli Mach a Šebestová ze školy a uviděli před domem stěhovací vůz. Paní Kadrnožková jim řekla, ať si jdou s Jonatánem hrát o něco dál, aby na ně při stěhování nespadla skříň. Ovšem stěhovákům vůbec jejich nepřítomnost nevadila a se školáky se zapovídali. Když stěhováci zjistili, že Jonatán je nejlepší pes na světě, odnesli jej sami do třetího patra. Jelikož byli tak hodní, Šebestová jim stěhování ulehčila a pomocí kouzelného sluchátka byl nábytek lehký jak pírko.

programme.title: Brundibáři (6)
programme.desc: Kratičké příběhy dvou čmeláků, kteří se stejně jmenují a navlas se sobě i podobají. Československý animovaný seriál

programme.title: Mach a Šebestová (7)
programme.desc: Jednou na začátku vyučování přišel do třídy pan ředitel a řekl, že žáci biologického kroužku si mohou na náklady školy pořídit nějaké zvířátko a to pozorovat. Samozřejmě nějakým zvířátkem myslel morče nebo křečka, a to z důvodu přijatelných finančních nákladů. Šebestová ale dostala nápad si pořídit slona. Tento návrh nebyl samozřejmě přijat a pan ředitel odešel. Učitelka pokračovala v látce, a právě hovořila o pirátech a jejich ukrytých pokladech.

programme.title: Broučci (1)
programme.desc: Animovaný loutkový seriál na motivy knihy Jana Karafiáta. Karafiátova kniha s ilustracemi Jiřího Trnky inspirovala už celou řadu adaptací a stále patří do zlatého fondu české dětské literatury. Tato filmová verze Broučků citlivě pracuje se známými hodnotami a snaží se je co nejvíce přiblížit dnešním dětem. Český animovaný loutkový seriál

programme.title: Tankový prapor
programme.desc: O službě vlasti a strastech i láskách rotného Dannyho Smiřického v naší armádě na počátku 50. let. Historky z vojenské služby za časů generála Čepičky podle slavné knihy Josefa Škvoreckého. Čerstvý doktor filozofie Daniel „Danny“ Smiřický je v rámci povinné vojenské služby přidělen k tankovému praporu ve vojenském prostoru Kobylec. Jako velitel tanku T-34/85 prodělává cvičení, jako kulturní pracovník je přítomen plnění Fučíkova odznaku a zažívá další příhody z vojenského prostředí 50. let.

programme.title: Mikrob
programme.desc: Alegorická černá groteska o tom, jak člověk ničí vlastní planetu na příkladu mikrobů v lidském těle, je pojata výtvarně i animačně velmi precizně kreslenou ultrafánovou animací. Zároveň se tu poprvé v autorově tvorbě objevuje odlehčený humor, střídající momenty, při nichž mrazí. Třeba když se z mikrobů stane pochodující stádo, vedené hlavním diktátorem či anti-happy end. Československý animovaný film

programme.title: Kinosál
programme.desc: V pořadu o nových filmech v kinech každý týden informujeme o nejzajímavějších a nejočekávanějších titulech v naší distribuci. V krátkých reportážích se zaměříme na zákulisí vzniku filmů, kuriozity z natáčení a výpovědi tvůrců. Přineseme rozhovory s českými a slovenskými filmaři, kteří v našich končinách stále více natáčejí své autorské projekty, a zachytíme jejich tvůrčí atmosféru. Filmová publicistika

programme.title: Smyk
programme.desc: Psychologické drama se špionážní zápletkou o emigraci a ztrátě identity. Františka Krále postihla v emigraci vážná automobilová nehoda a musel se podrobit plastické operaci. S novou tváří a pod změněným jménem se vrací do Prahy jako nepřátelský agent. Setká se svou rodinou a začíná pochybovat o smyslu své špionážní činnosti. Psychologické drama se špionážní zápletkou se zabývá otázkou emigrace, vztahu jednotlivce ke společnosti a problém ztráty lidské identity.

programme.title: Filmové minuty
programme.desc: Filmové minuty přinášejí souhrnné filmové zpravodajství ze světa filmu, aktuality, ocenění, výročí, nové a připravované projekty a mnoho dalšího z domova i ze zahraničí... Filmová publicistika

programme.title: Pějme píseň dohola
programme.desc: Téměř zletilý Ondra se chce stát co nejdříve dospělým v sexuální oblasti. Hořká retro komedie pro všechny nešťastníky, kteří byli alespoň jednou na pionýrském táboře. Zavzpomínejte! Vyzáblý dlouhán Ondra má málo zkušeností, ale velké předsevzetí: chce se stát co nejdříve dospělým, hlavně v oblasti sexuálních zkušeností. Na kamarádovo doporučení volí funkci praktikanta na pionýrském táboře. Brána letního tábora se otevírá a Ondru čekají mnohá životní poučení.

programme.title: Hadí jed
programme.desc: Ani dcera nedokáže přemluvit svého otce, aby se zbavil své alkoholové vášně. Kolik promile lásky postaví člověka na nohy? Josef Vinklář v jedné ze svých životních rolí ve filmu o boji s démonem alkoholu. Mladičká dívka se rozhodne vyhledat svého otce, jehož jméno i adresu zná jen ze zasílaných alimentů. Po rozpačitém shledání záhy pochopí, že otec, pracující na geologickém průzkumu, je těžký alkoholik, reagující tak na svůj zpackaný život. Sám kdysi studoval na inženýra, ale školu nedokončil.

programme.title: O zatoulané princezně
programme.desc: Pohádka o tom, co je víc než celé království. O statečné princezně, která před ženichem uteče do světa. Filmová pohádka na motivy Josefa Lady. Princezna Jůlinka se má podle přání svého královského otce vdávat, ale radši se vydá z rodné Královské Lhoty do světa. Na svých potulkách se spřátelí se strašidlem Mulisákem a s vodníkem Brčálem. Spolu s nimi se rozhodne zachránit život mladého artisty Františka Kuldana, který si získal její srdce. Mezi cirkusáky se totiž princezna cítí nejlépe.

programme.title: Strach
programme.desc: Major Kalaš vyšetřuje řadu vražd souvisejících s minulostí. V pozadí případu stojí strach ctihodných občanů z prozrazení jejich temné minulosti. Na silnici u pohraničního městečka v noci přejede automobil úmyslně mladého, asi dvacetiletého muže. V mrtvém poznají místní jednoho ze studentů, který tam byl na brigádě. Do Kromperku přijíždí major Kalaš s nadporučíkem Vargou.

Ohlížejí se za Coleovými úspěchy v dresu Arsenalu i Chelsea, včetně kontroverzního přestupu mezi dvěma londýnskými rivaly, který vyvolal velké emoce. programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (22)
programme.desc: Mr Bean is dismayed to find that the bin men are refusing to take his wheelie bin because the lid won’t shut as it’s too full of rubbish - and by the time he’s shut it, they’ve gone! So he sneaks the bin in front of other houses, hoping they won’t notice and pick it up. Meanwhile, Mrs Wicket realises that her purse has ended up in the rubbish, and is chasing Mr Bean… who is chasing the bin men!

But the Lemmings, who are riding on the back of a bucking caribou, realize that the flower makes their mount sneeze, which only makes the game ten times more fun!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (33)
programme.desc: Grizzy finds two identical vases that are actually communicating vessels in a Native American Indian chest. If he sticks his hand in one, it comes out the other, between them. This should satisfy Grizzy's natural lazy streak, regardless of the distance unless the Lemmings realize the incredible games they could play with the magic vases.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (34)
programme.desc: Grizzy finds a vintage stopwatch in the garage which lets you wind back the minute that has just passed by and it can even stop time and movement in one's surroundings. This will give him a sure advantage over the Lemmings, provided of course they don't get their hands on it.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (35)
programme.desc: Grizzy is disturbed in the middle of his TV snack by a strange flow of incongruous objects that have been transformed into hot-air balloons. When he sees the Lemmings onboard these curious zeppelins, Grizzy understands that he will quickly have to confiscate their helium tank and balloons if he wants to relax in front of the TV.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (36)
programme.desc: Grizzy discovers with great delight that the ranger has purchased a brand new multifunction Stressless recliner. But even an armchair designed for well-being - the ultimate in relaxation - can used for other purposes by the Lemmings, who transform it into a fearsome multi-game chair.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (37)
programme.desc: The Lemmings play kite-surf with a homemade kite. Grizzy notices that the she-bear he's in love with watches the kite perform arabesques in the sky with admiration. He decides to make a kite that is far more sophisticated than the Lemmings kite.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (38)
programme.desc: Grizzy snatches the last jar of chocolate spread out from under the noses of the Lemmings. In exchange, he offers them the toy stuck inside the lid: a mini-flute. When the Lemmings blow into the flute, the shrill notes that come out paralyze anyone whose ears aren't plugged for several seconds. They decide to play a tune for Grizzy in order to recover their share of chocolate spread.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (39)
programme.desc: The Lemmings play a new game, floating like flags in the breeze from the fan which is set at maximum. Grizzy, who has decided to watch his favorite TV documentary on salmon fish, quickly rids the living room of this interference. But he didn't anticipate that the Lemmings would continue their game on the roof with the wind pump and TV antenna, and that the interference would reappear... inside the TV!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (40)
programme.desc: The Lemmings have a grand old time tearing down their Kapla block buildings, which they rebuild just as fast. Grizzy remarks that the she-bear he's in love with is impressed by the Lemmings' construction and makes believe that it's his work of art. But when the building collapses yet again, the she-bear walks off. Grizzy decides to build an even bigger one.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (41)
programme.desc: The Lemmings draw inspiration from lessons they find in a martial arts book and start breaking every wooden object they can get their hands on into two. When Grizzy tries to stop them, they go on to the next lesson and get him in a judo hold. Grizzy understands that he needs the book so that he too can become a pro.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (42)
programme.desc: Grizzy dreams that he's a valiant knight who has just delivered his beloved. As he is about to take her in his arms, he is woken by the din of the Lemmings, who have chosen this particular day to blast music. Grizzy has only one desire: pick up his dream where he left off. But first, he'll have to stop the Lemmings' fiesta.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (43)
programme.desc: Grizzy stands in front of the pantry, desperate. The stock of chocolate spread is completely depleted. He realizes that the Lemmings are making some themselves, following a complicated recipe. If they can make it, then why can’t he?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (44)
programme.desc: Inspired by a magazine with a jewelry ad showing a man offering a diamond to a woman, Grizzy imagines himself offering the ranger's engagement ring to his beloved she-bear. But the big diamond set in the ring has disappeared. The Lemmings, who are having a spinning-top contest, are using it as the ultimate top. And they have no intention of giving it up.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (45)
programme.desc: When he accidentally sticks a computer microprocessor to his temple, Grizzy is transformed into an exceptionally intelligent being capable of predicting events to come far in advance. With his way above average IQ, not only will he be able to provide himself with the latest high-tech comfort, getting rid of the Lemmings should be a piece of cake.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (46)
programme.desc: The Lemmings prepare a dream afternoon snack with the last jar of chocolate spread in the cupboard. Tough luck, Grizzy is coming! Caught off guard, the Lemmings hide the jar in a teddy bear-pajama case to slip away without arousing suspicion. But Grizzy is captivated by the stuffed bear and makes it his security blanket.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (30)
programme.desc: Irma and Mr Bean are at the cinema to see the three hour long “Romance In Paris”, which Mr Bean is not looking forward to. But when he sees that they are also showing an action movie - Zombie Aliens 3 - he finds a way to sneak out and into the other screen. But will he get past the usher, and what will happen when Irma notices?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (31)
programme.desc: When a TV show offers cash to film in haunted homes, Mr Bean invites a film crew over and rigs his flat up to make it as spooky as possible - wobbly picture frames on wires, eerie noises on a tape recorder and a good old-fashioned sheet for a ghost. But will the tricks be convincing enough to win Mr Bean the money?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (18)
programme.desc: When his model aeroplane is blown out of the sky by that of a rival kid, Mr. Bean sets his sights on revenge. Next day, his newly constructed fighter plane, almost ready for take-off, sadly lacks a vital part - and the blinking model shop is shut! No matter. It’s chocks away with Teddy at the controls, fighting for airspace over London N10.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (19)
programme.desc: When Mr. Bean breaks his favourite Royal mug he discovers there's only one place to buy a replacement: Buckingham Palace, home of the Queen of England. When one of Her Majesty's corgis runs off with his teddy, Bean gives chase through secret tunnels… and gets lost.

programme.title: Moley (46)
programme.desc: MoleTown’s orchestra is performing, and everyone is impressed with Milo’s new hat until Moley accidentally breaks it. Moley must come up with a way to get Milo’s hat back to normal and fast!

programme.title: Moley (47)
programme.desc: When the Gardener finally gets his hands on Manny, Moley and Dotty are on his trail, so he dresses up as the world’s greatest Mole detective and lead them away from the clues.

programme.title: Moley (48)
programme.desc: Mishmosh’s new de-aging device causes trouble when it accidentally zaps Miss Petunia and Old Coot into their younger selves. But Moley soon discovers that the de-aging doesn’t stop and he and his friends must rescue them before it’s too late.

programme.title: Moley (49)
programme.desc: Moley and Dotty go on a wild adventure after getting transformed into worms, only to discover that Squirm comes from a whole new alien world that has been under MoleTown the entire time!

programme.title: Moley (50)
programme.desc: When Mishmosh falls ill and is unable to compete in MoleTown’s greatest inventor competition, Moley and Dotty must dress up and compete in his place against other great Mole inventors!

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables (20)
programme.desc: With Sumush out of town, both Mush-Mush and Fung think that they are now the strongest Mushables in Mushton. But neither of them counts on the strength of Lilit and Miff!

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables (21)
programme.desc: Chep is super happy to have Amanita become a collector as well. Until she starts getting better at collecting than he is!

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables (22)
programme.desc: Our Mushlers discover a super-sticky tree sap and use it to have lots of fun… until Mush-Mush gets stuck to Muddler’s back.

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables (23)
programme.desc: When things go missing from everyone’s home-trees, our Mushlers get on the case to catch the culprit.

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables (24)
programme.desc: Morel notices a Mushlet who is too shy to join in with the others. He realizes why the Mushlet is so shy - they are in awe of Mush-Mush. Morel gets Mush-Mush to boost the Mushlet’s confidence.

programme.title: SuperThings: Rivals of Kaboom - Kazoom Power (31)
programme.desc: Magnetikus guides a giant meteor toward Kaboom City. Astroturbo, a newcomer, must stop it before it ends Kaboom City.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (28)
programme.desc: Tom and Jerry awake to the smell of eggs being cooked in the kitchen - Ginger and Rick are making breakfast courtesy of their neighbor's fresh eggs. Ginger and Rick talk about how their new neighbor has a suburban henhouse and is raising their own produce. Tom and Jerry team up to target the henhouse for a heist, but it's easier said than done.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (29)
programme.desc: A little baby goat butts his head through a distant wall of the estate and starts nibbling the grass. At first, he helps Tom with the yardwork but then causes chaos throughout the manor. Tom and Jerry are left to deal with the kid.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (30)
programme.desc: On another scary night in the castle, The Invisible Cat wants nothing more than to catch mice. After it picks up and carries Jerry and Tuffy, Tom is really confused (and spooked) to see the two mice "magically" float through the air! When Tom accidentally smacks The Invisible Cat in the face and knocks Jerry and Tuffy free of his hold, it sparks a slapstick fight between the two cats.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (31)
programme.desc: As Rick and Ginger prepare for a costume party, Tom tries to score some snacks. Jerry and Tuffy are out to do the same. Spike and Tom are initially confused by the guests' costumes. Determined to get their paws on as much party food as they can, however, they contrive their own costumes to crash the party. Will they get away with it?

programme.title: Batwheels (21)
programme.desc: Bam brings Catwoman's Catmobile, Kitty, to life so the Batwheels can have even teams for their game of "Bat-Ball," but the Kitty "Kitty" is too wild to be contained, despite Bam's best attempts to convince her to play along.

programme.title: Batwheels (22)
programme.desc: Everyone assumes that Harley Quinn is the culprit in a recent burglary. But as Batman and Bam pursue Harley, Bibi and Redbird begin to suspect that she may actually be innocent.

programme.title: Ben 10 (25)
programme.desc: During a tour of the Japanese Robotics Museum, Ben finds hero-gone-wrong Tim Buktu "trying to save" Tokyo from a Dragon. Has Tim finally turned over a new leaf, or is this just another one of his half-baked plans to play the part of hero?

programme.title: Ben 10 (26)
programme.desc: At Biggie Box Japan, Ben waits in an epic line for the release of the latest Sumo Slammers video game, Cyber Slammers, but Ben must soon save the store, not from game-hungry customers, but from Steam Smythe, who wants to retro-fit a massive mech with steam punk powers!

programme.title: Ben 10 (11)
programme.desc: Ben must go alien to save the Hoover Dam from disaster, but when tough guy hero Tim Buktu swoops in to "help", Ben must figure out if Tim is friend... or foe.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (14)
programme.desc: Grizzy does his best to get rid of the Lemmings and enjoy some peace and quiet in the cabin, but each time they come back with a new and even more-disturbing activity. When he sees some penguins marching in a perfectly disciplined line, Grizzy decides to teach the Lemmings how to behave in his presence. He locks himself up with them inside the garage, which has been transformed into an elementary school classroom.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (15)
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings fight once again and cause an accident with Santa Claus’ sled. The Lemmings rush to the crash site and get their hands on Santa’s magic bag. While Grizzy is tidying up the cabin after their fight, he is baffled to see the Lemmings come back him, quiet and calm. The rodents break out into Christmas carols and prepare a delicious snack for Grizzy before slipping out again.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (16)
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings do not agree on which program to watch on TV. Grizzy confiscates the remote-control device. He thinks he’s won the battle, but the Lemmings find another one at the research station. A furious combat begins until the adversaries realize that the research station device has a special button that controls objects.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (17)
programme.desc: The Lemmings have a blast racing down the ice slope in competition with the stuffed Bear-Ranger and manage to win each time. Grizzy cannot stand seeing his avatar humiliated and he decides to enter the competition to help him. Their frenzied descent gets out of hand and everyone is propelled all the way to the hangar of the research station, where they discover an ultra-sophisticated racing game. The racecourse sprawls over the entire icefield via drones that project holographic elements.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (18)
programme.desc: Grizzy watches the Lemmings shave ice from the icefield and whip it into granita, but the result is flavorless. He decides to make granita in an empty jar of Yummy so that the chocolate left over on the sides of the jar will flavor the dessert. It’s delicious! The Lemmings, who consider it was their recipe, swap the chocolate granita with another one made in an old flowerpot with potting soil. The choco-granito race is off and running!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (19)
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings are starving for their reserves are depleted and their fishing has been unsuccessful. Fortunately, a truck delivers a crate of edibles to the research station that contains compact food cubes. When placed under a special light beam, the cubes retransform into delicious meals. Grizzy discovers that the decompressing lamp can, conversely, compact organic elements too. For example, the Lemmings.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (20)
programme.desc: The Lemmings pace around the log cabin searching for virtual animals to capture with their tablet game. Annoyed by their behavior, Grizzy throws them outside. Determined to continue playing, the Lemmings trick the bear. But when the tablet hits the circuit breaker and explodes, the gaming animals come to life! Ice dinosaurs, laser caribous and giant carnivorous plants. The life-size hunt can begin!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (21)
programme.desc: A snowstorm rips the solar panels off the log cabin and Grizzy can no longer watch TV or enjoy the comforts of home! But he has a brilliant idea. He produces electricity by making a caribou run on a treadmill, using the last carrot in the house as bait. But the Lemmings absolutely want his carrot to make the perfect snowman.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (22)
programme.desc: Grizzy discovers in shock that the TV has been replaced with a trompe-l’oeil image. Furious, he flushes the Lemmings out of their hiding place where they’d hoped to watch their favorite cartoon in peace and propels them as far as possible. They land in an ancient cave where a powerful spirit capable of entering individuals is asleep. The Lemmings decide to free the spirit and send it to Grizzy. But will they be able to control the spirit?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (23)
programme.desc: Not easy to enjoy a DVD about salmon when the Lemmings are having a disco party right there. Grizzy sends them packing with such force that they land at the research station, where they discover a state-of-the-art U.V. cabin. When turned up to the max, the light therapy and music options can advantageously replace the disco equipment Grizzy destroyed. The noise they make causes a block of ice to break off. It hurdles down the slope to the cabin and destroys Grizzy’s TV.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (24)
programme.desc: The Lemmings have fun destroying ice towers. When Grizzy sees them, it inspires him to sculpt statues of himself. The Lemmings cannot resist the temptation to destroy the statues of Grizzy, who does everything in his power to protect them.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (25)
programme.desc: A container adrift along the icefield will change the lives of Grizzy and the Lemmings: it’s an inexhaustible stock of chocolate spread! There is so much, that for the first time the close enemies have no need to fight over the treat. They entice a flock of penguins into hoisting the container out of the water. One of the penguins, who did not get his reward in fish, is disgruntled. Grizzy has him taste the Yummy, then throws the jar far away to get rid of the penguin.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (26)
programme.desc: Grizzy uses a fire extinguisher to chase the Lemmings from the living room so that he can take a nap, but the gadget accidentally flies out the window. It lands at the top of an ice cliff, causing a fissure, and the peak of the cliff topples. Amid the debris, the Lemmings discover a fearsome creature: the Yeti, who is looking for the guilty party. The Lemmings bring him to Grizzy, never dreaming that the giant will immediately fall in love with the Ranger’s cabin and throw a very original party.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (15)
programme.desc: Mr Bean receives a delivery of a bunch of flowers for Mrs Wicket, but accidentally runs them over in the his car. He can’t afford to replace them, so he decides to recreate the bunch by taking flowers one by one from anywhere he can - a vase in a café, a wedding bouquet, even from between the teeth of a tango dancer! But will he assemble the bunch and be back in time for Mrs Wicket?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (16)
programme.desc: Mr Bean gets so engrossed playing with Mr Paliwal’s new drone that he doesn’t notice a car thief stealing his car. They quickly jump into Mr Paliwal’s car and use the drone to track the stolen car to the thief’s warehouse hideout. Using the drone, they discover a criminal car-stealing operation - but will they be able to outwit the car thieves using Mr Paliwal’s flying gadget?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (17)
programme.desc: Irma is dragging a very bored Mr Bean around a shopping centre when he spots a competition for Minty Mints - pull your silliest face for a photo and win a cash prize! Mr Bean tries to queue but it’s too long - so he persuades Irma to visit a photo studio offering romantic photoshoots. Can Mr Bean get away with pulling funny faces and submit the photo to the Minty Mints people without Irma knowing?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (18)
programme.desc: When Scrapper claws a rip in Teddy, Mr Bean rushes him to the Teddy hospital. As Teddy is being fixed, Mr Bean is rather taken with another Ted on sale in the shop. He decided to take Big Ted home with him once Teddy is fixed. But at home it seems as though Big Ted is freezing Teddy out, and after a particularly terrifying nightmare, Mr Bean realises he has to get rid of his new guest.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! (13)
programme.desc: The gang tours an old Hollywood Studio, but they soon uncover a mystery concerning the ghost of a silent film comedy star who has returned to make sure his recently discovered final film is never seen!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! (14)
programme.desc: Fred lives out his childhood dream of being a stage magician as he and the gang go uncover at a private magic club being terrorized by a mutant Rabbit monster!

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (1)
programme.desc: Ginger brings home a new pet—a mynah bird who can mimic anyone and anything. Rick complains about the money they will have to spend to feed and care for another pet. Spike and Tom are on notice, as somebody's got to go.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (2)
programme.desc: It's that special time of year when the Lady of the House's rare, exotic (and very stinky) cheese gets delivered to the manor. It's up to Tom to make sure not a crumb of this cheese—known to be a favorite of mice—goes missing.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (3)
programme.desc: Ginger decides she wants to teach Tom to walk on a leash to ensure he gets much-needed exercise. Tom hates the leash and does not want to go for a walk. Finally, they're on their way, much to Tom's chagrin. Back home, Jerry and Tuffy proceed to raid the fridge.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (4)
programme.desc: Ginger leaves some frozen fish on the kitchen counter to thaw. Ginger and Rick warn Tom to keep his paws away, or he will not get anything to eat. Soon, a live baby octopus crawls out of the mouth of one of the thawing fish and jumps off the counter, looking for a place to hide. Jerry befriends him and does his best to protect him from Tom.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (5)
programme.desc: Up to their usual antics, Tom, Jerry and Spike get into monkey business with a drone at Rick and Ginger's house.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (6)
programme.desc: It's time for the annual croquet tournament at the Manor. The butler tells Tom how important it is to the Lady of the Manor to always win…no matter what! The last thing they need is any pesky rodents interfering with the game. Knowing any sighting of Jerry or Tuffy would cast Tom in a bad light, he's determined to keep them off the lawn.

programme.title: Tom and Jerry Gokko (2)
programme.desc: Tom is taking selfies and enjoying a sweet snack at the candy shop, when Jerry and Tuffy sneak up and eat his strawberries. Tom proceeds to chase after them, but Tuffy falls into the claw machine. Jerry tries to save him, and Tom fishes them out. Tom makes Tuffy cry and apologizes by feeding him sweets.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (38)
programme.desc: Mr Bean needs to see a very rare bird so he can tick off every page in his bird-spotting book. But he soon gets bored as he waits in a hide for the rare bird to appear. Instead he goes home and paints a picture of the bird cuts it out and sticks it high up a tree in the back garden. Soon he is besieged by excited twitchers who think it really is the rare bird. They are all keen to get a snap and they’re willing to pay good money for a peek.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (39)
programme.desc: Mr Bean finds himself babysitting a baboon.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (40)
programme.desc: Mr Bean fancies a game of golf so he creates his own golf course inside his flat and invites Irma to join him for a round. Their somewhat eccentric game takes them from sitting room to bathroom and through Mrs Wicket’s flat as they battle to be the winner of the First Bean Open Championship.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (49)
programme.desc: How does one choose tasteful wallpaper these days? After watching a royal documentary on TV, Mr. Bean decides to decorate his room in the style of Buckingham Palace. If the Queen’s new wallpaper is good enough for Her Royal Highness, then it’s going to be good enough for him. Meanwhile, his landlady, Mrs. Wicket, suffers from illusions of grandeur and crowns herself Queen of the street.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (50)
programme.desc: Mr. Bean finds himself in a race to grow a giant marrow with his next-door neighbour. There’s prize money at stake and a chance to get his photo in the papers. And so, as the competition gets tough, Bean’s gardening techniques become more ingenious, unconventional and desperate.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (41)
programme.desc: A crafty cat burglar is causing alarm and concern throughout the town with a series of daring rooftop robberies. After Mrs Wicket’s house is burgled and Bean has his wallet stolen he decides the only way to deal with this cunning housebreaker is to don a costume and become a superhero (like the ones in his favourite comic book). But Super Bean soon finds he has his hands full helping to rescue cats stuck in trees and old ladies with their spilled shopping.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (42)
programme.desc: Mr Bean is tidying his flat and chucking out a load of old unwanted junk. Unfortunately during the big clear out Teddy accidentally falls into a bin bag which gets put out in the street. Bean is horrified when the rubbish van arrives and he realises that dear old Teddy is now on his way to the landfill. Bean races across town to the dump but how will he ever find his friend amongst all the mountains of junk?

programme.title: Tom and Jerry Gokko (4)
programme.desc: Tom is enjoying his bath time while Jerry bathes Tuffy. Tuffy ends up floating off in a bubble and lands in Tom's bath. Jerry throws in all of the bath bombs creating a massive amount of bubbles. In the end, they all work together to get clean.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings (7)
programme.desc: The Baby Lemmings discover that an ant convoy marching in formation to a berry bush and back can be turned into a fun game of “conveyor belt” for them. However, their irascible neighbor, Baby Beaver, diverts the convoy so that the ants start transporting his sticks for him instead. When Baby Castor loses control of the ants and finds himself in trouble, the Baby Lemmings come to the rescue with an even more fun game!

programme.title: Baby Lemmings (8)
programme.desc: The baby lemmings are having a picnic but have a nasty tendency to get raspberry juice all over themselves. When one of the baby lemmings dirties baby Raccoon, who has just finished washing up, baby Raccoon decides to take matters into his own hands and wash them. But the baby lemmings get dirty immediately! Baby Raccoon decides to teach them some manners!

programme.title: Baby Lemmings (9)
programme.desc: Baby Chipmunk is trying to carry a ton of nuts back to her den, but climbing down the cliff with all her nuts is proving a complex task. As for the baby lemmings, they've discovered the principle of the slide and are having fun building a longer and longer one. When the baby chipmunk sees this, she sees a great opportunity to get her nuts down more cheaply.

programme.title: Batwheels (31)
programme.desc: When a group of alley dogs, aided by a heroic stray, are saved from Catwoman by kind-hearted Buff, he brings them all back to live in the Batcave, unbeknownst to the rest of the Bat-Family.

programme.title: Batwheels (32)
programme.desc: When Jestah injures herself preparing for an extreme sports competition with the other Zoomers, Bibi helps her overcome her fear of going to the mechanic so she can heal up in time to compete.

programme.title: Meet the Batwheels (1)
programme.desc: An action-packed music video of the Batwheels' most exciting adventures set to an extended version of the series' theme song.

programme.title: Ben 10 (1)
programme.desc: When Grandpa Max's engineer buddy Phil Billings gifts Team Tennyson the Omni-Copter, a state of the art flying vehicle that can transport the Rustbucket for overseas adventures, Steam Smythe takes to the skies to ground Ben and company's first test flight; but unbeknownst to our heroes, Smythe was sent to battle Ben's latest alien forms by a mysterious, powerful enemy: the Forever Knight.

programme.title: Ben 10 (2)
programme.desc: During one last stop by a toy store before Ben, Gwen, and Grandpa Max's maiden voyage across the Atlantic, Ben runs into an old bully, Kevin 11, who now has new powers. He's able to transform into aliens just like Ben, such as the "bootleg" doppelgänger of Cannonbolt... Wreckingbolt!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! (13)
programme.desc: The gang tours an old Hollywood Studio, but they soon uncover a mystery concerning the ghost of a silent film comedy star who has returned to make sure his recently discovered final film is never seen!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! (14)
programme.desc: Fred lives out his childhood dream of being a stage magician as he and the gang go uncover at a private magic club being terrorized by a mutant Rabbit monster!

programme.title: Lamput (32)
programme.desc: Lamput spends the day at the beach, and, in a pair of swimming trunks, cuts a fine figure indeed. That is to say; a small, round and blobby figure. It only takes one snide comment from a fellow beach-goer to bring Lamput's body issues to the surface. When you're a shape changer, though, there's no need for exercise; before long Lamput is strutting along as an orange amalgam of all the best-looking sunbakers. On the up side, it's a handy disguise when the Docs come a-hunting. On the down side?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (1)
programme.desc: Inspired by a wildlife documentary on TV, Mr. Bean dusts off his camera and treks deep into the countryside in search of the perfect wildlife photograph. After two fruitless days of being the hunter, he is somewhat miffed to find himself the hunted.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (5)
programme.desc: Mr Bean is watching Clint Chiseljaw - his favourite action TV show - with Billy, but Mrs Wicket orders her nephew downstairs to finish his chores. Inspired by Clint’s catchphrase - “Nobody gets left behind”, Mr Bean tries a variety of different daring plans to break Billy out of Mrs Wicket’s flat. But none of them work, until he hits on the perfect plan… or so he thinks!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (6)
programme.desc: Mr Bean peers through the window of the opening party of an art exhibition and sees free snacks being handed around - yum! But he’s told by the bouncer that he needs to be smartly dressed. So he sneaks into the artist’s studio and paints a tuxedo onto himself. This time he’s let in, but will Bean’s fake painted suit last long enough for him to get his free food?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (7)

Clive (Adrien Brody) a Elsa (Sarah Polleyová) se specializují na propojování DNA různých zvířecích druhů a vytvářejí tak fantastické nové hybridy.

programme.title: Ničivé tornádo
programme.desc: Tornádo je zlo, se kterým nelze bojovat. Nejde ho porazit ani zastavit, vždy vyhraje. Jediná možnost na přežití je ukrýt se před ním. A potom počítat ztráty. K záchraně života je třeba včasné varování, ale kdo by v oblastech, kde se tornáda běžně nevyskytují, sledoval, jestli nehrozí nebezpečí? Jen náhodou objeví blížící se hrozbu April Saundersová (Mimi Rogers), která se už roky zabývá zkoumáním přírodních živlů.

programme.title: Arthur: Prokletí
programme.desc: Alex je už od dětství fanoušek filmu Arthur a Minimojové. Na svoje narozeniny ho jeho nejlepší přátelé překvapí a vezmou do domu, kde se film točil. Nikdo z nich netuší, že jde o zlověstnou a smrtelnou past. Z dětského snu se brzy stává hrůzná noční můra. Francouzský horor

programme.title: Cesta za pokladem
programme.desc: Cesta za pokladem nebo mýty a legendy ze světa peněz je šestidílný veselý příběh pro děti o sourozencích Maxovi a Mili, kteří se vydají na cestu za pokladem, aby mohli koupit narozeninový dárek své mamince. Maxovi a Mili na jejich cestě pomáhá babi Majka a její pejsek Money. V každé epizodě se děti naučí něco zajímavého ze světa peněz a navíc zjistí, co vše může být vzácné jako poklad. Slovenský naučně-zábavný seriál

programme.title: Kikirikí
programme.desc: Kohoutek a slepička se stali nerozlučnými kamarády. Mají se velmi rádi, v noci spí vedle sebe na bidýlku a přes den spolu gazdují na dvoře. Kohoutek neustále něco vymýšlí, je nespokojený a slepička s ním všechno trpělivě řeší. Každý příběh v sobě ukrývá ponaučení, jak se stát lepším a neubližovat lidem, kteří nás mají rádi. Slovenská pohádka

programme.title: Kouzlování
programme.desc: Máte rádi kouzla, tajemství a čáry? V kouzelnické show vám renomovaný kouzelník poodhalí tajemství svých triků. Slovenský zábavný pořad (skryté titulky)

programme.title: Zabij nudu!
programme.desc: Dochází vám fantazie, co dělat doma s dětmi? Je tu pořad, v němž dostanete návod, jak spolu smysluplně prožít společně strávený čas. A také jak vyrobit jedinečné věci, které oživí vaši domácnost. Zažijete přitom určitě spoustu zábavy! Jsou to věci funkční, dekorační nebo jen pro zábavu, například pomůcky do školy, pokladničky či žertovné ozdoby. Slovenský tvůrčí pořad

programme.title: Staré pověsti české (12)
programme.desc: Animované Staré pověsti české vznikly ve vlastní produkci televizí CS Film a CS Mini. Producenti televize hledali velký příběh, který by připomínal tradice a naši minulost. Jan Werich o Jiráskovi, podle jehož námětu byl seriál natočen, řekl: „Kdyby Jirásek žil v Hollywoodu, byl by milionář, protože měl výborné zápletky.“ Oslavoval český národ, ale ne na úkor jiných. Tu a tam zušlechťoval naši historii a prokládal ji sentimentálními příběhy, a tak nám ji přibližoval a činil bližší.

programme.title: Mach a Šebestová (7)
programme.desc: Jednou na začátku vyučování přišel do třídy pan ředitel a řekl, že žáci biologického kroužku si mohou na náklady školy pořídit nějaké zvířátko a to pozorovat. Samozřejmě nějakým zvířátkem myslel morče nebo křečka, a to z důvodu přijatelných finančních nákladů. Šebestová ale dostala nápad si pořídit slona. Tento návrh nebyl samozřejmě přijat a pan ředitel odešel. Učitelka pokračovala v látce, a právě hovořila o pirátech a jejich ukrytých pokladech.

programme.title: Broučci (1)
programme.desc: Animovaný loutkový seriál na motivy knihy Jana Karafiáta. Karafiátova kniha s ilustracemi Jiřího Trnky inspirovala už celou řadu adaptací a stále patří do zlatého fondu české dětské literatury. Tato filmová verze Broučků citlivě pracuje se známými hodnotami a snaží se je co nejvíce přiblížit dnešním dětem. Český animovaný loutkový seriál

programme.desc: Před mnoha a mnoha lety, kdy lesy byly plné zvěře a ptactva, vládl horám u pramenů Labe Krakonoš. Nejednou pomohl chudákům v nouzi a potrestal ty, kterým příliš narostl hřebínek. V té době žil v Krkonoších i poslíček Frantík. Celý den běhal po horách od chalupy k chalupě, jednomu přinesl psaní, druhému balíček. A je třeba přiznat, že Frantík byl poslíček pilný, přičinlivý a ochotný. Možná až přepilný a přeochotný, zvláště, když mohl sobě přilepšit a jiného napálit...

programme.title: Děvčata, nedejte se!
programme.desc: Situační komedie z dívčího internátu. Najdete-li za svými dveřmi koš a v něm nemluvně, neztrácejte hlavu. Třeba vám někdo pomůže s péčí o něj. Nesmělý středoškolský profesor konečně získá místo v církevním internátu pro dívky z lepších rodin. Před odjezdem na nové působiště nalezne před svými dveřmi nemluvně. Tajně se o dítě stará a studentky mu konspirativně pomáhají. Středoškolský profesor Emanuel Pokorný po dlouhé nezaměstnanosti konečně dostal místo v dívčím penzionátu na venkově.

programme.title: Čardášová Julie
programme.desc: Humorná romance oživlých kostýmů v divadelní šatně. Československý animovaný film

programme.title: Pelíšky
programme.desc: Jemná poetika, humorná nadsázka a životní osudy tří generací ve zvláštním období našich dějin v roce 1968. Hvězdně obsazená retrokomedie o dvou svérázných rodinách od renomovaných tvůrců, režiséra Jana Hřebejka a scenáristy Petra Jarchovského. V dvoupatrové pražské vile žijí dvě rodiny - Šebkovi a Krausovi. Otec Šebek, prostoduchý, ale dobrácký důstojník z povolání, je zastáncem panujícího režimu a stejně vehementně obhajuje i vlastní neomylnost v roli hlavy rodiny.

programme.title: a zase ta Lucie!
programme.desc: Pokračování rodinné komedie Lucie, postrach ulice. Další veselá dobrodružství šestileté Lucie a jejích neobyčejných kamarádů, kouzelných panáčků z formely, kteří se jmenují Ferda a Ferda. Osvald, zbavený cti být vůdcem dětské party, připravuje strašlivou pomstu. Lucie se bude divit, až se zmocní jejích formeláků Ferdy a Ferdy a podstrčí jí za ně napodobeniny zbavené všech kouzel!

programme.title: Myš, která prochází zdí
programme.desc: Pohádka podle komiksových příběhů populární čtveřice, ve které se odehrává vše kolem zázračné schopnosti procházet zdí. Česká animovaná pohádka

programme.title: Kinosál
programme.desc: V pořadu o nových filmech v kinech každý týden informujeme o nejzajímavějších a nejočekávanějších titulech v naší distribuci. V krátkých reportážích se zaměříme na zákulisí vzniku filmů, kuriozity z natáčení a výpovědi tvůrců. Přineseme rozhovory s českými a slovenskými filmaři, kteří v našich končinách stále více natáčejí své autorské projekty, a zachytíme jejich tvůrčí atmosféru. Filmová publicistika

programme.title: Naděje
programme.desc: Syrový příběh dvou životních ztroskotanců, mravně nahlodaného alkoholika a prostitutky, kteří se po mnoha karambolech a ubližování sblíží. Na okraji velké průmyslové stavby 60. let se náhodně setkají alkoholik Lucin a prostitutka Magdalena. Setkání se postupně změní v citové pouto, které jim vrátí důstojnost a dává novou naději do dalšího života. 60. léta 20. století.

programme.title: Skřivánci na niti
programme.desc: Nevyčerpatelnost a krása života překonávají i ty nejhorší překážky v době bezohledné a prolhané diktatury. Lyrická groteska Jiřího Menzela o politických „provinilcích“ na motivy povídek Bohumila Hrabala z knihy Inzerát na dům, ve kterém už nechci bydlet. Satirický film z roku 1969 zůstal dvacet let uzavřen v trezoru, protože vypovídal o absurdní realitě padesátých let a odkrýval skutečnosti, jež měly zůstat skryty. Premiéru měl v lednu 1990 a na MFF Berlinale získal hlavní cenu Zlatého medvěda.
